latest_features: Public updates now publish an encrypted C7.dll.pkg payload, and the injector decrypts it locally before injecting so the public repo no longer exposes a directly usable DLL
The injector keeps validating the decrypted C7.dll against the manifest SHA-256 before injection, so the existing integrity check still protects the runtime payload
Public release mirroring now ships C7.dll.pkg instead of C7.dll while keeping the injector and version manifest on the public repo update path
First-run proxy helper downloads now create the AppData Tools cache directory before writing C7-WorldProxy.exe, fixing clean-machine helper bootstrap failures
